profiles.name: Cyn Starter
profiles.author: Cyn contributors
profiles.description: Beat-responsive bass and more vocal presence. Synthetic feature training only; personalize with More/Less.

profiles.name: Cyn Cinema AI
profiles.author: Cyn contributors
profiles.description: Experimental Movie & Series profile: dialogue-forward Clarity and restrained Bass; synthetic-feature-trained, not speech-aware. Start here and teach your preferences with More/Less.

profiles.name: Cyn Real Audio 13h (Experimental)
profiles.author: Cyn contributors
profiles.description: 13 hours of neural training on real spoken audio and instrument notes. Better heuristic prediction on a held-out set; actual listening quality has not been verified. Import to try it without changing your current model until you select it.

profiles.name: CYN APEX Flow Hybrid (Live Preview)
profiles.author: CYN contributors
profiles.description: Selectable Music AI for Cyn 2.0.47+: real pretrained YAMNet recognition + 13h-trained Bass/Clarity preference weights + separate passage-flow DSP control for builds, drops and breakdowns. Opt-in, reversible and peak-gated. Not the offline APEX-6M denoiser; not listening-validated.

profiles.name: CYN APEX 6M (Full Neural Preview)
profiles.author: CYN contributors
profiles.description: Official full 6,307,477-parameter APEX ONNX neural audio model. Download the standalone Windows WAV processor, adjust neural processing strength and compare the saved audio. Existing 225-step synthetic denoising checkpoint; NO new training. Not a 209-weight CYN AI profile, and not real-time system playback. Requires manual download; never auto-executes.
